@@name@@Blighted Quiver@@icon@@false@@icon2@@Blighted Quiver 2.png@@description@@'''Passive:''' '''Varus'''' [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attacks]] are empowered to deal '''bonus''' magic damage and apply a [[File:Stack icon.png|20px|link=Stack|An icon representing the keyword Stack]] [[:Stack|stack]] of ''Blight'' [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]] for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times. '''Varus' ''' [[File:Champion ability.svg|20px|link=Champion ability|An icon representing the keyword Champion ability]] [[:Champion ability|abilities]] detonate all ''Blight'' stacks on affected enemies hit.@@description2@@'''Blight:''' For each stack consumed, the target is dealt '''bonus''' magic damage. If the stacks were consumed with ''[[File:Varus Piercing Arrow.png|20xpx|border|link=Varus#Piercing Arrow|An icon for Varus's ability Piercing Arrow]] [[Varus#Piercing Arrow|Piercing Arrow]]'', this damage is increased by 0% – 50% (based on [[File:Varus Piercing Arrow.png|20px|border]] ''Piercing Arrow's'' charge time). This damage is capped at 120 per stack against [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monsters]], for a total cap of 360 at maximum stacks.

Additionally, each stack consumed against a [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champion]] or epic [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monster]] reduces the '''remaining''' cooldowns of '''Varus' ''' basic abilities by 13% of each of their '''total''' cooldowns, up to a 39% cooldown reduction per target. If the stacks were consumed with ''[[File:Varus Piercing Arrow.png|20xpx|border|link=Varus#Piercing Arrow|An icon for Varus's ability Piercing Arrow]] [[Varus#Piercing Arrow|Piercing Arrow]]'', the cooldown reduction is increased by 0% – 50% (based on [[File:Varus Piercing Arrow.png|20px|border]] ''Piercing Arrow's'' charge time), up to a 39% – 58.5% cooldown reduction per target from consuming maximum stacks against them.@@description3@@'''Active:''' '''Varus'''' next ''[[File:Varus Piercing Arrow.png|20xpx|border|link=Varus#Piercing Arrow|An icon for Varus's ability Piercing Arrow]] [[Varus#Piercing Arrow|Piercing Arrow]]'' within 5.5 seconds is empowered to deal '''additional bonus''' magic damage, increased by 0% – 50% (based on [[File:Varus Piercing Arrow.png|20px|border]] ''Piercing Arrow's'' charge time). This damage is capped at 360 against [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monsters]].@@description4@@If '''Varus''' does not cast ''[[File:Varus Piercing Arrow.png|20xpx|border|link=Varus#Piercing Arrow|An icon for Varus's ability Piercing Arrow]] [[Varus#Piercing Arrow|Piercing Arrow]]'', ''Blighted Quiver'' can be recast after 1 second within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards or when he dies. ''Blighted Quiver'' can be cast during the first 0.85 seconds of ''[[File:Varus Piercing Arrow.png|20xpx|border|link=Varus#Piercing Arrow|An icon for Varus's ability Piercing Arrow]] [[Varus#Piercing Arrow|Piercing Arrow's]]'' charge, and will be placed on full cooldown after the charge ends even if ''[[File:Varus Piercing Arrow.png|20xpx|border|link=Varus#Piercing Arrow|An icon for Varus's ability Piercing Arrow]] [[Varus#Piercing Arrow|Piercing Arrow]]'' is not recast.@@description5@@'''Recast:''' '''Varus''' ends ''Blighted Quiver'' and places it on a 1-second cooldown.@@description6@@''Blighted Quiver's active and recast can both be used while affected by [[File:Silence icon.png|20px|link=Crowd_control#Disrupting|An icon representing the keyword Cast-inhibiting crowd control]] [[:Crowd_control#Disrupting|cast-inhibiting crowd control]].''@@leveling@@
